title: Printable
goal: The struct won't print. Grant it the right capability.
hints: {:?} is the Debug format - it asks the type for the Debug trait specifically.
Display can't be derived - it's for human-facing output you design by hand. Debug is the mechanical one.
explanation: println!("{config:?}") requires the Debug trait (E0277 without it), and #[derive(Debug)] writes the boring implementation for you. Clone grants the wrong capability entirely - copyable, still unprintable. And Display is deliberately underivable: user-facing formatting is a design decision, so the macro that would guess it doesn't exist. Traits are specific capabilities; grant the one that's actually demanded.
